item.title: Weekly Moment With the Rebbe
item.description: What was Chabad’s take on the secular character of Israel? Quick to condemn or defend? The Avner Institute presents an unusual, newly released yechidus about the establishment of the State of Israel from the archives of Rabbi Nissan Mindel, longtime aide of the Previous Rebbe and Rebbe, expressing the latter’s disappointment in the outcome of the United Nations, yet powerful hope for the future and vision of the final redemption. Full Story

item.title: Drinking Responsibly: Kashrus of Alcoholic Drinks
item.description: As Purim approaches, many will be purchasing or receiving alcoholic beverages. Many local, Jewish-owned stores do not take responsibility for the kashrus of their drinks. Rather, they rely on you to be an educated consumer and know what you are purchasing. Full Story
